definition: Memorize means to fix something in your memory exactly, so you can call it back word for word without looking.
task: Write one sentence of your own using the word memorize. Make the sentence show what the word means -- a reader who did not know memorize should be able to work it out from your sentence.
avoid_verbatim: Old helmsmen memorized all thirty-two points of the compass in order, boxing the whole rose from north to north before anyone trusted them at the wheel.
Review is weaker than memorize: reviewing passes back over the material to refresh it, while memorizing fixes it exactly, ready to repeat without looking.
Internalize goes deeper than memorize: memorized words can be recited on cue, but internalized ideas have soaked in so far they guide you without any conscious recall.

Retain is about keeping: information already learned stays put instead of fading. Memorize names the deliberate work at the front end — fixing the material exactly, word for word, so there is something to retain. You memorize the speech on Tuesday and hope to retain it by Friday.

Rehearse means to run something through repeatedly to prepare — and you can rehearse with the script still in your hand. Memorize means the words themselves are stored, exact and complete, so the page can close. A cast rehearses for weeks; each actor must also memorize the part.

To drive one of London's black cabs, applicants must pass an exam called the Knowledge, and most spend three to four years preparing for it.
The test allows no maps and no phone.
Candidates must memorize some twenty-five thousand streets and the quickest legal line between any two of them.
Ana rode her scooter through the city every evening, then sat at her kitchen table reciting runs aloud with her eyes shut, her atlas closed on the shelf.
Examiners would name two addresses and wait.
Hesitation was allowed; peeking was not — the route had to come back word for word, turn by turn, from memory alone.
When Ana finally passed, she mailed the atlas to her cousin.
She no longer needed the book: the city was written where no one could take it from her.
